get.summary: List graphs (scoped callers see only bound graphs of their tenant)
get.description: Requires the admin token, the read-only token, or a scoped credential with graph_read whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]). Collection scope never implies graph scope. Runs under one database read guard. Signed-in accounts get graph_read (viewer) or graph_read and graph_write (editor), narrowed by their graphs and graph_access knobs. Graphs are tenant-owned: a tenanted principal (tenant credential or tenanted signed-in account) uses tenant-local names, stored as t<tenant_id>__<name> (at most 28 bytes locally), and responses show the tenant-local name; other callers use stored names.

post.description: Requires the admin token or a scoped credential with graph_write whose graphs binding names the new graph (or is ["*"]). Graphs are tenant-owned: a tenanted principal (tenant credential or tenanted signed-in account) uses tenant-local names, stored as t<tenant_id>__<name> (at most 28 bytes locally), and responses show the tenant-local name; other callers use stored names.

node.description: Exactly one of id or key

id.description: u64 as a canonical decimal string (preferred) or JSON integer

limits.description: Unset fields use GraphLimits::DEFAULT (max_hops 2, max_visited_nodes 1000, max_edges_examined 10000, max_edges_per_node 1000, deadline_ms 250, max_output_nodes 100, max_output_edges 200, max_output_paths 20). Values above the ceiling (4, 10000, 100000, 10000, 5000, 1000, 2000, 100) are rejected with 422 graph_limit_exceeds_ceiling, never clamped.

schema.description: Same JSON as vlite-graph-cli: graph, view_sequence (decimal string), complete, truncation, stats, cursor, and node | edge | nodes | edges | paths | shortest_path. Results carry graph structure only, never vector record data.

post.description: Requires the admin token or graph_write on this graph. attach, detach, put_vector and delete_vector additionally require the write operation and a collection binding covering each named collection, and delete_node does the same for every collection attached to the node. Collection names are matched exactly as stored, never tenant-qualified: a tenanted signed-in account names its own collections t<tenant_id>__<name>. Live-vector quotas apply. Runs under the database write guard as one durable frame; nothing is written on error.

items.description: One of create_node, upsert_node, patch_node, delete_node, create_edge, patch_edge, delete_edge, attach, detach, put_vector, delete_vector (vlite-graph-cli batch JSON).

409.description: graphs_not_enabled or a graph conflict (graph_key_exists, graph_node_not_found, graph_attachment_conflict, graph_schema_violation, ...)

422.description: invalid_json, invalid_input (more than 4096 operations, invalid vector or metadata)

get.summary: Declared schema plus the observed one (bounded scan)
get.description: Requires the admin token, the read-only token, or a scoped credential with graph_read whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]). Collection scope never implies graph scope. Runs under one database read guard. The observed schema scans at most budget entities (default 100000, at most 1000000); complete is false when the scan stopped early.

400.description: invalid_path or invalid_query (unknown parameter, bad budget)

put.description: Requires the admin token or a scoped credential with graph_write whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]); the read-only token gets read_only. Runs under the database write guard. An empty schema ({}) removes the declaration. Existing data must satisfy the new schema; the change is one graph revision.

409.description: graphs_not_enabled, graph_not_found, or graph_schema_violation (existing data violates the schema)

413.description: Body above the server JSON limit

422.description: invalid_json (unknown field, duplicate key) or invalid_input (inconsistent schema)

post.summary: Hybrid retrieve: vector/text pivots, bounded expansion, record evidence
post.description: Requires the admin token, the read-only token, or a scoped credential with graph_read whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]). Collection scope never implies graph scope. Runs under one database read guard. Retrieve returns vector record data, so a scoped credential also needs the read operation and a collection binding covering the pivot collection (forbidden_scope otherwise). Evidence from collections the credential may not read is dropped and counted in redacted (per-hop evidence authorization); the admin and read-only tokens see every collection. Outputs never contain vectors.

403.description: forbidden_scope: credential lacks graph_read, the graph is outside its graphs binding, or it may not read the pivot collection

409.description: graphs_not_enabled (vector-only file), graph_not_found or another graph conflict

422.description: invalid_json (unknown field, bad ID), invalid_input (no vector or text, bad dimensions), graph_pivot_too_expensive, graph_limit_exceeds_ceiling

post.summary: Run (or explain) a read-only graph query text
post.description: Requires the admin token, the read-only token, or a scoped credential with graph_read whose graphs binding names this graph (or is ["*"]). Collection scope never implies graph scope. Runs under one database read guard. The text (docs/GRAPH-QUERY.md) maps to exactly one typed read; the answer is the typed route's answer, or the explain route's answer with explain: true.

200.description: The typed read's output, or its explanation

403.description: forbidden_scope: credential lacks graph_read or the graph is outside its graphs binding

409.description: graphs_not_enabled (vector-only file), graph_not_found or another graph conflict

422.description: graph_query_syntax, graph_query_unsupported, graph_query_parameter, graph_query_limit, invalid_json or graph_limit_exceeds_ceiling

get.summary: Graph read/write guard hold times (admin only)
get.description: Hold time of the database guard per graph request in microseconds over the most recent 4096 samples (nearest-rank p50/p99, max), total counts and truncation counts by reason since start.
